description: This file contains build configuration and scripting for Linux kernel compilation within the OpenWrt build system, including kernel patching, initramfs setup, and image creation.

methods.name: Kernel/Prepare/Default
methods.description: Prepares the kernel source, either by extracting from a tarball or linking to an external kernel tree.

methods.name: Kernel/SetInitramfs/PreConfigure
methods.description: Prepares the kernel configuration for initramfs, adjusting .config based on various build options.

methods.name: Kernel/SetInitramfs
methods.description: Sets up the initramfs configuration, including compression options and root permissions.

methods.name: Kernel/SetNoInitramfs
methods.description: Removes initramfs configuration from the kernel source.

methods.name: Kernel/Configure/Default
methods.description: Configures the kernel build, copying kernel settings and generating .config files.

methods.name: Kernel/Configure/Initramfs
methods.description: Configures the kernel for initramfs using specified parameters.

methods.name: Kernel/CompileModules/Default
methods.description: Compiles kernel modules and saves configuration state.

methods.name: Kernel/CopyImage
methods.description: Copies kernel images and binaries to the build directory.

methods.name: Kernel/CompileImage/Default
methods.description: Builds the kernel image and copies it to the target directory.

methods.name: Kernel/PrepareConfigPerRootfs
methods.description: Prepares a kernel configuration directory for a specific root filesystem.
